title: Experiment type
description: Type of experimental procedure used to generate the biological data.

title: Nucleic acid extraction protocol
description: Protocol used to extract nucleic acids from the biological sample.

title: DNA Microarray Chip
description: Microarray chip or platform used for the assay.

title: Nucleic acid labeling protocol
description: Protocol used to label nucleic acids prior to hybridization or measurement.

title: Nucleic acid hybridization to array protocol
description: Protocol describing the hybridization of labeled nucleic acids to the microarray.

title: Array scanning and feature extraction protocol
description: Protocol used to scan the microarray and extract measurable features from the array image.

title: BioSample Accession Number
description: Accession identifier assigned to the biological sample.

title: Library Source
description: Biological source material from which the sequencing library was prepared.

title: Library Preparation Kit
description: Commercial or standardized kit used to prepare the sequencing library.

title: Library Preparation Kit Version
description: Version of the library preparation kit used in the experiment.

title: Adapter Sequence
description: Nucleotide sequence of the adapter incorporated into the sequencing library.

title: Read Length
description: Length of the sequencing reads generated by the sequencing run.

title: Acquisition software
description: Software used to control or operate the mass-spectrometry data acquisition process.

title: Acquisition parameter
description: Parameters defining how mass-spectrometry data are acquired, including scan and precursor-selection settings.

title: MS level
description: Mass-spectrometry level indicating the stage of mass analysis, such as MS¹ or MS².

title: Scan polarity
description: Ionization polarity used during mass-spectrometry scanning, such as positive or negative mode.

title: Analysis software
description: Software used to analyze or process mass-spectrometry data after acquisition.

title: Data processing parameter
description: Parameter controlling or describing computational processing of mass-spectrometry data.

title: Imaging System
description: Instrument or system used to acquire biological or scientific images.

title: Imaging Software Name
description: Software used to control the imaging system or acquire, process, and analyze images.

title: Imaging Technique
description: Imaging method or technique used to acquire the image data.

title: Detector
description: Device used to detect emitted or transmitted signal during image acquisition.

title: Excitation Wavelength
description: Wavelength of light used to excite the sample.

title: Detection Wavelength
description: Wavelength or wavelength range used to detect the emitted or transmitted signal.

title: Pixel Size
description: Physical dimensions represented by each image pixel or voxel.
